name: Earth Atlas: Picture Games
subtitle: Maps, capitals, animals & more
shortDescription: Play the planet on real maps: capitals, rivers, mountains, animals and more. Capital Cities is free; others have a free preview.
longDescription:
Earth Atlas: Picture Games is a set of geography games on real maps. See a country on its map and flag, a river's path or a mountain's country, then tap the city, animal, river, mountain, climate or neighbour that belongs to it.

Capital Cities is free to play. Each of the other ten games is a one-time purchase, with no subscription, and every one of them can be tried free for 90 seconds of play first.

### The Games
- Capital Cities (free): the country on its map and flag, three city cards with clues
- Find It on the Map: put every country in its place
- Country Sizes and Populations: guess how big it is or how many people live there
- Neighbours and World Regions: who borders whom, and where it lies
- Which Animal Lives Here?: read the range map, spot the animal
- Which River or Lake?: follow the water across the map
- Which Mountain Is This?: spot the peak or volcano by its country
- What's the Weather Like?: pin a city, pick its climate
- Which Food Comes From Here?: from dumplings to cheeses, find the home country
- Which Language Is Spoken Here?: match countries and their languages
- Where Did It Happen?: launches, flights, expeditions and quakes by country

### Geography Games for Everyone
Country maps, world capitals, capital cities, animals of the world, rivers and lakes, mountains and volcanoes, map games, neighbours, population and regions: learn geography by playing. Every play draws fresh countries and animals from the whole world, or you can pick a continent. Wrong cards grey out so you can try again.

### Also Inside
- Optional quizzes and flashcards on every topic
- Text size from 100% to 300%, five colour themes and a reduce-motion setting

Plays offline once installed (ads load only when online): no account or sign-in needed. Every game lists the sources of its facts, such as Natural Earth and United Nations statistics.

Purchases are handled by the App Store. Capital Cities is free; each other game has a free 90-second preview, then a one-time purchase of US$0.99 (price varies by country).
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
